name: tokensentinel
description: Catch coding-agent token waste mid-run: tool loops, retry storms, search thrash. Observe by default; optional strict block.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe (default) = annotate only; alert = same local, cloud stamp; strict = deny tools when waste fires (requires healthy runtime)

cloud_endpoint.title: Cloud endpoint
cloud_endpoint.description: Optional TokenSentinel cloud API base URL. Leave empty for offline.

api_key.title: Cloud API key
api_key.description: Optional. Only used when cloud endpoint is set.
